document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You’re assigned a battered black Peugeot and a bright-eyed young 
Egyptian. He speaks some English but has no particular interest 
in your mission. Roll 1D10: with a result of 1,2, or 3 go to 321; 
for any other result, go to 324.
(320)
